 Judgment
~~~~~~~~~ Petitioner challenges Ext.P6 order of the 2 nd respondent whereby he has been directed to stop unauthorised fish vending in the building owned by one Raghavan Nair.
2. The petitioner submits that he has been engaged in fish vending for long years.
After the Panchayat started a public market, the Panchayat is insisting that no fish vending will be permitted within 3 KM radius of the public market.
According to the petitioner, the stipulation is against the statutory rules and he cannot be forced to stop his business.
3. On instructions, the Standing Counsel for the 1st respondent - Grama Panchayat submits that Ext.P6 is an appealable order.
Respondents 1 and 2 have filed a counter affidavit in which it has been so stated.
In view of the availability of alternate remedy, I do not deem it necessary to entertain this writ petition.
Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed of permitting the petitioner to approach the 1st respondent and prefer an appeal against Ext.P6 order.
If the petitioner prefers an appeal within four weeks, the 1st respondent will consider it and pass appropriate orders thereon.

If the petitioner prefers such an appeal as directed above, the interim order passed by this Court in this writ petition will continue to enure to the benefit of the petitioner, till the 1st respondent takes a final decision in the appeal.

Sd/-
N. NAGARESH, JUDGE aks/09.04.2019 APPENDIX
